So here on the 4-hour chart as you can see there's not much going on but I do have something very important to talk about and that is the S&P 500 chart on the weekly. Right now I believe we are doing the exact same thing, first of all we dropped below the bm support band, which by the way happened exactly after we got e-crossed right there, well actually not exactly, but we got e-crossed, the price went up for the short term just like we did back in that area after we got e-crossed we formed a new high in the short term but then we dropped below the bm support band, we also dropped below the moving average on the weekly RSI. And right now we're going to test it, just like we did back in that area. But in my opinion, if the price does not manage to close a wick above the bull market support band right there, and even if it closes a wick above the moving average, it's probably going to mean that we're exactly at that point of the cycle. What is interesting about this move is that it's also happening at the exact same time. So back here, when we got this move to the downside this low was back in february and the previous slow that we got a couple of weeks ago was let's say in march and this move to the upside that you know we got to the bar market sport band happened at the end of march and right now the move that we are doing you know at this moment is happening at the beginning of april so it's not really a huge difference i think it's pretty much the exact same setup, and we're probably gonna get rejected very soon, which is going to lead to a 27% drop and that is gonna be the perfect time for the S&P 500 chart to get to the oversold territory again, which by the way has not happened many times in the past, each time it did that, for example back in this area over here, it got above the bar market support just a couple of weeks later, or a couple of months later, and that's what gave us new all-time highs and I think it's pretty much gonna play out the exact same way of course this goes pretty well with the fact that I'm expecting between to get another drop so when Bitcoin ends up dropping to maybe like 40 000 to complete the third drop of the cycle that's gonna be the perfect time for the s p 500 chart to get a move like this and to get to the oversold territory. I hope this was not too boring, if it was, please let me know. That's pretty much it, I hope you enjoyed. prices were likely at this point!
